scope_verdict: M180 is a real executable dual-window K4 reference: legal-token behavior, backpressure, same-cycle handoff/refill, zero tokens, cross-descriptor source conservation and the constructive top-four selector are credible. It should not advance as the primary FC2 architecture because 1.129841x analytic schedule opportunity is bought with 10.966839x M177 logic area, only 0.103023 conditional opportunity per logic-area ratio, zero rounded setup margin and 161 logic levels.

independent_partial_window_vcs.finding: The RTL implementation supports nonzero partial final windows, but the primary sealed 52-descriptor population used only exact multiples of D and did not test this behavior.

constructive_top4_audit.selection_rule: Select the four largest remaining nonzero bank populations, lower-bank tie break, then earliest stored source in each selected bank.
constructive_top4_audit.conclusion: The selector is constructive for the per-window K4 group lower bound. This does not validate the M179 full-payload cycle total through RTL because frozen payloads were not replayed through M180.

protocol_boundary_finding.observed: A header with output_blocks=1 and descriptor_count=5 is accepted with protocol_error=0 even though stage0 has only four legal absolute beat indices.
protocol_boundary_finding.effect: A quiet producer can leave the token permanently unfinishable; a producer that sends a fifth descriptor eventually faults at descriptor time. The existing three attacks therefore prove their named cases, not complete protocol fail-close.
protocol_boundary_finding.required_fix: Check header_descriptor_count against the stage beat extent at header acceptance and add over-extent attacks for all four stages.

verified_dc.qualification: The five explicit report_constraint classes are clean and no TIM-209/OPT-150 loop signature exists. The non-clock tie-high fanout remains an informational TIM-134 net, and rounded setup slack is zero under ideal-clock/ZeroWireload assumptions; this is not placed-and-routed timing margin.

k8_direction.reason: The independently reviewed M181 same-depth K8 schedule is 97,607,807 cycles, 1.307079853x faster analytically than M180/M179 top4 K4's 127,581,198 cycles, and fixed bank ownership removes the global top-four bank sorter. M180 remains the matched K4 reference rather than being deleted.
k8_direction.boundary: This is an exact-payload analytic scale point only. K8 still needs eight-bank weight response, eight accumulator lanes, bounded D8 reservoir VCS/SVA and matched Synopsys DC before any physical or complete-FC2 claim.

P0.finding: M180 buys only 1.129841x analytic opportunity with 10.966839x M177 logic area and conditional opportunity-per-area 0.103023. The critical path already reaches 161 levels and 0.0000 ns rounded setup slack.
P0.required_action: Freeze M180 as the executable global-top4 K4 reference. Do not spend the next milestone optimizing this sorter; advance a bounded D8 K8 fixed-bank implementation and compare it against M180 under identical VCS/DC constraints.

P0.finding: M180 excludes native descriptor production, directory generation/lookup cost, exact frozen-payload RTL replay, four-bank weight response, M169 arithmetic, accumulator context and commit.
P0.required_action: Keep all M179/M180/K8 ratios analytic. Require composed weight response and accumulator service plus matched cycle/PPA before admitting physical or complete-FC2 speedup.

P1.finding: Impossible descriptor counts are accepted in the header. Review VCS observed output_blocks=1, descriptor_count=5 accepted without protocol_error.
P1.required_action: Add a stage-dependent header count bound and four over-extent attacks; prove no legal header can create an unfinishable token.

P1.finding: The sealed main population contains zero tokens and full windows but no nonzero partial final window. The review-only VCS proves all four stage modes work.
P1.required_action: Move partial-window cases for D2/D4/D8 into the exact-SHA primary regression and add an explicit SVA cover for partial close.

P1.finding: The 3 ns run reports 161 levels, group_ready-to-group_source_channel critical path and 0.0000 ns rounded setup slack under ideal clock and ZeroWireload.
P1.required_action: For any retained K4 implementation, register or hierarchy-pipeline group handoff/selection and rerun with nonzero margin. For K8, precommit a shallower fixed-bank selector and matched timing bound.

P1.finding: The decisive same-cycle release-and-refill corner has only one hit in both sealed and fresh-seed runs.
P1.required_action: Add repeated release/refill sequences with stalls at every boundary and assertions for buffer ownership, no overwrite and eventual token completion.

P1.finding: The executable control is not driven by the 120 frozen M51 payload records and reordered source delivery is not connected to arithmetic/accumulation.
P1.required_action: Replay materialized groups or a representative exact subset through RTL and compose the numeric miter before claiming the analytic recurrence is executable end to end.

P2.finding: The directed scoreboard and independent partial VCS check unused lanes are zero, but the bound SVA lacks a direct unused-lane-zero assertion.
P2.required_action: Add per-slot assertions that bank and channel are zero whenever slot is outside group_source_count.

P2.finding: All five explicit constraint classes are clean at maxfanout16, yet dc.log still reports clk_core and tie-high n31756 as TIM-134 high-fanout nets.
P2.required_action: Say 'five report_constraint classes clean'; do not imply every physical net is buffered below 16 before CTS/tie-cell insertion.

P2.finding: The contracts are correctly pre-run and retain false admission flags; RUN_COMPLETE carries the pass state.
P2.required_action: If a single machine-readable admission object is desired, add a non-destructive post-run overlay keyed to both RUN_COMPLETE hashes rather than editing the precommit contracts.
